name: Fatboy Slim
description: The iconic British DJ brings his infectious energy to Porto for a massive open-air show. Get ready to dance the night away to legendary big beat anthems under the stars.
longDescription:
Norman Cook, known professionally as Fatboy Slim, is a British DJ, musician, and record producer. He rose to prominence in the 1990s with his distinctive big beat sound, characterized by heavy breakbeats and funk samples. His career spans several decades, marked by numerous hit singles and albums that have influenced electronic dance music globally. This event features a live performance by the artist at The Park, an open-air venue in Porto.

Attendees can expect an evening of high-energy electronic music, suitable for those interested in dance music and live DJ sets. The atmosphere will be geared towards dancing, with the performance taking place outdoors. The event is scheduled for the evening of May 1, 2026, offering an opportunity to experience an international DJ in a large-scale setting.

Tickets for the event are available starting from €30. The Park is located within Porto, and specific public transport links will be announced closer to the date. Accessibility information is not currently available.
